notes.title: New update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.starlaxis.de/Update.jpg[/img]

A new update is available and offers you:
[list]
[*]a progress bar for the enemies which shows you when they act
[*]faster loading times
[*]a hint system which informs you about nice gameplay tricks
[*]bug fixes
[/list] 

We hope you enjoy it! ;)
